tokens.name: --gridkit-surface
tokens.description: The background of the header, footer, toolbar, group-by bar, pager and menus, and of their buttons and fields.

tokens.name: --gridkit-surface-muted
tokens.description: The background of a hovered row, cell, header, button or option, and of group rows.

tokens.name: --gridkit-line
tokens.description: Borders, separators and the lines between rows and columns.

tokens.name: --gridkit-hover-line
tokens.description: The outline of a hovered cell and the edge of a column being resized.

tokens.name: --gridkit-fg
tokens.description: The text of the toolbar, pager, menus and fields, while cells and headers keep the page's own text colour.

tokens.name: --gridkit-fg-muted
tokens.description: Secondary text, icons and the scrollbar thumb.

tokens.name: --gridkit-accent
tokens.description: Focus rings, drop indicators, the current page, and the marks of an active sort, group, filter or check.

tokens.name: --gridkit-selected
tokens.description: The background of a selected row, column or cell, a focused menu item and a group-by chip.

tokens.name: --gridkit-selected-strong
tokens.description: The background of a selected row, column or cell while hovered, and of a toolbar toggle that is on.

tokens.name: --gridkit-header-bg
tokens.description: The background of the header row, and of a header while it is dragged.

tokens.name: --gridkit-header-fg
tokens.description: The text colour of the header row, which by default keeps the page's own, as cells do.

tokens.name: --gridkit-group-row-bg
tokens.description: The background of group rows and of their summary rows.

tokens.name: --gridkit-row-hover-bg
tokens.description: The background of a hovered row.

tokens.name: --gridkit-row-stripe-bg
tokens.description: The background of every second row, transparent by default so that rows are not striped.

tokens.name: --gridkit-focus-ring
tokens.description: The ring around a focused cell, header, button or field.

tokens.name: --gridkit-accent-fg
tokens.description: A mark drawn on an accent fill, such as the tick in a checked filter value.

tokens.name: --gridkit-error
tokens.description: The border of an invalid filter value and the message under it, by default the accent turned red.

tokens.name: --gridkit-scrollbar-thumb
tokens.description: The thumb of the grid's own scrollbars.

tokens.name: --gridkit-overlay-shadow-color
tokens.description: The colour of the shadow under menus, the column chooser and the filter menu.

tokens.name: --gridkit-font-family
tokens.description: The grid's font, the page's own by default.

tokens.name: --gridkit-font-size
tokens.description: The size of the text in cells, headers, group rows and the footer.

tokens.name: --gridkit-menu-font-size
tokens.description: The size of the text in menus, the column chooser and the filter menu.

tokens.name: --gridkit-bar-font-size
tokens.description: The size of the text in the toolbar, the group-by bar and the pager.

tokens.name: --gridkit-hint-font-size
tokens.description: The size of a menu item's shortcut and a filter value's count, and five sixths of the size of a header's sort priority.

tokens.name: --gridkit-header-font-weight
tokens.description: The weight of header labels.

tokens.name: --gridkit-header-text-transform
tokens.description: The case of header labels, such as uppercase, the page's own by default.

tokens.name: --gridkit-header-letter-spacing
tokens.description: The letter spacing of header labels, the page's own by default.

tokens.name: --gridkit-group-font-weight
tokens.description: The weight of a group row's label, of subtotals and of grand totals.

tokens.name: --gridkit-font-variant-numeric
tokens.description: Set to tabular-nums to give every digit the same width, so that numbers line up down a column.

tokens.name: --gridkit-spacing
tokens.description: The unit the grid's paddings, gaps and control heights are multiples of, so a smaller one makes the whole grid denser and a larger one roomier.

tokens.name: --gridkit-cell-padding-x
tokens.description: The horizontal padding of cells, group rows, summary rows, the footer and the loading row.

tokens.name: --gridkit-cell-padding-y
tokens.description: The vertical padding of cells, group rows, summary rows, the footer and the loading row, which sets how tall a row is.

tokens.name: --gridkit-header-padding-x
tokens.description: The horizontal padding of header cells, the cells' own by default.

tokens.name: --gridkit-header-padding-y
tokens.description: The vertical padding of header cells, which sets how tall the header is, the cells' own by default.

tokens.name: --gridkit-toolbar-padding
tokens.description: The padding around the toolbar's entries.

tokens.name: --gridkit-group-by-bar-padding
tokens.description: The padding around the group-by bar's chips.

tokens.name: --gridkit-pager-padding
tokens.description: The padding around the pager's bar and page-size picker.

tokens.name: --gridkit-menu-item-padding-x
tokens.description: The horizontal padding of a menu item.

tokens.name: --gridkit-menu-item-padding-y
tokens.description: The vertical padding of a menu item, and of the filter menu's sort and submenu entries, which are drawn as menu items.

tokens.name: --gridkit-border-width
tokens.description: The width of every line the grid draws, from the lines between rows and columns to the borders of its bars, menus, buttons and fields.

tokens.name: --gridkit-border-style
tokens.description: The style of the lines between rows and columns, around the grid, and between the grid and its toolbar, group-by bar and pager.

tokens.name: --gridkit-row-line-width
tokens.description: The width of the lines between rows, and under the header and over the footer, wherever the grid's borders setting draws them; 0 turns them off.

tokens.name: --gridkit-column-line-width
tokens.description: The width of the lines between columns, wherever the grid's borders setting draws them; 0 turns them off.

tokens.name: --gridkit-outer-border-width
tokens.description: The width of a border around the whole grid, which has none by default.

tokens.name: --gridkit-radius
tokens.description: The corner radius of the grid's outer frame and of the pager bar.

tokens.name: --gridkit-menu-radius
tokens.description: The corner radius of menus, the column chooser and the filter menu.

tokens.name: --gridkit-control-radius
tokens.description: The corner radius of buttons, fields and options in the toolbar, the pager, the column chooser and the filter menu, whose checkboxes take three quarters of it.

tokens.name: --gridkit-icon-size
tokens.description: The size of the icons in the toolbar, the pager, menus and the filter menu, of the filter menu's checkboxes and a group-by chip's remove button, and of the triangle on a group row.

tokens.name: --gridkit-header-icon-size
tokens.description: The size of a header's sort, group and filter icons.

tokens.name: --gridkit-focus-ring-width
tokens.description: The width of the ring around a focused cell, header, button or field.

tokens.name: --gridkit-indicator-width
tokens.description: The width of the line along a column being resized, of the marks where a dragged column or chip would land, and of the group-by bar's outline while it is a drop target.

tokens.name: --gridkit-overlay-shadow
tokens.description: The offsets and blur of the shadow under menus, the column chooser and the filter menu, whose colour is --gridkit-overlay-shadow-color.

tokens.name: --gridkit-menu-min-width
tokens.description: The narrowest a menu can be.

tokens.name: --gridkit-column-chooser-width
tokens.description: The width of the column chooser.

tokens.name: --gridkit-filter-menu-width
tokens.description: The width of a column's filter menu.

tokens.name: --gridkit-column-chooser-max-height
tokens.description: The tallest the column chooser's list grows before it scrolls.

tokens.name: --gridkit-filter-checklist-height
tokens.description: The height of the list of values in a column's filter menu.

tokens.name: --gridkit-transition-duration
tokens.description: How long the triangle on a group row takes to turn as the group opens or closes.
